ingredients.name: 1 Piece S-type Airlock
ingredients.description: S-shaped airlock that allows CO2 to escape during fermentation while preventing contaminants from entering your vessel. Features two chambers so you can easily monitor bubble activity during secondary fermentation.

ingredients.name: 71cm/28" Plastic Mash Paddle
ingredients.description: Durable 28-inch food-grade plastic paddle designed for stirring grain during the mash process. Will not scratch mash tuns or coolers, and its length helps prevent dough balls from forming during all-grain brewing.

ingredients.name: 71cm/28" Plastic Spoon
ingredients.description: 28-inch long plastic spoon ideal for stirring and mixing during all stages of homebrewing without scratching equipment. The extended length reaches into larger kettles and fermentation vessels with ease.

ingredients.name: Auto Siphon (Easy Siphon) 3/8"
ingredients.description: Acrylic auto siphon (3/8" diameter) that starts a siphon with just one pump stroke for easy racking and transfer between vessels. BPA-free construction with a sediment guard tip to leave trub and lees behind.

ingredients.name: Belgian Candi Syrup, Amber D-45 - 1lb
ingredients.description:
This syrup is actually made in Belgium, and is the same sugar that the breweries themselves are using to craft their smooth, rich, and malty beers that have been enchanting home brewers for years. 

Amber Candi Syrup possesses rich overtones of toffee and caramel.

ingredients.name: Bentonite
ingredients.description: Absorbent clay fining agent that binds and precipitates suspended proteins and particles, effectively clarifying wine, cider, and mead while reducing haze. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Bottle Filler Wand 3/8"
ingredients.description: Spring-loaded bottling wand with automatic shutoff valve that fills bottles with precision control and minimal foam when pressed against the bottle bottom. Prevents drips and reduces oxidation between fills.

ingredients.name: Brewer's Best Natural Flavoring Black Currant 4 oz
ingredients.description: All-natural black currant flavoring concentrate providing rich, dark berry character. Use at approximately 1 oz per gallon to add complex fruit notes to beer, wine, cider, or mead.

ingredients.name: Brewer's Best Natural Flavoring Cherry 4 oz
ingredients.description: All-natural cherry flavoring concentrate for beer, wine, or mead. Add during or after fermentation at approximately 1 oz per gallon for vibrant fruit character without artificial taste.

ingredients.name: Brewer's Best Natural Flavoring Cranberry
ingredients.description: All-natural cranberry flavoring concentrate with tart, bright fruit character. Ideal for fruit beers, ciders, and specialty beverages at approximately 1 oz per gallon.

ingredients.name: Brewer's Best Natural Flavoring Lemon 4 oz
ingredients.description: All-natural lemon flavoring concentrate delivering bright citrus notes without harshness. Use at approximately 1 oz per gallon to enhance wheat beers, witbiers, and fruit beverages.

ingredients.name: Briess Dry Malt Extract Golden Light 3lbs
ingredients.description: Versatile base dry malt extract made from a blend of base and carapils malt. Slightly darker than Pilsen Light, it provides malty flavor and good gravity boost for a wide range of beer styles.

ingredients.name: Briess Dry Malt Extract Pilsen Light 3lbs
ingredients.description: Light-colored brewer-grade dry malt extract with clean malt flavor and excellent body. Use alone for light lagers and pilsners, or combine with specialty grains for partial-mash recipes of any style.

ingredients.name: Bung #10 Drilled
ingredients.description: Rubber stopper with a drilled center hole designed for PET plastic carboys, Better Bottle fermenters, and similar fermentation vessels. Accepts standard S type and 3 piece airlocks for secure fermentation sealing.

ingredients.name: Bung #7 Drilled
ingredients.description: Rubber stopper with a drilled center hole for use with standard airlocks, sized to fit glass carboys. Prevents oxygen entry while allowing fermentation gases to escape safely.

ingredients.name: Calcium Carbonate (Chalk)
ingredients.description: pH buffer salt used to raise and stabilize mash pH in soft or acidic brewing water. Particularly beneficial for dark beer styles like stouts and porters. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Calcium Chloride
ingredients.description: Brewing water chemistry salt that adds calcium and chloride ions to your water, enhancing enzyme activity, yeast health, and malt sweetness. Commonly used to emphasize malt character over hop bitterness. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.description: Tart acidulant used in fruit wines, ciders, and meads to adjust acidity and add brightness. Best added after fermentation to avoid conversion by yeast. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Coriander Seed Whole 1 oz
ingredients.description: Whole coriander seed with a fruity, citrusy character traditionally used in Belgian witbiers and saisons. Crack or lightly crush before adding late in the boil to release bright, spicy aroma.

ingredients.name: Corks 1+1 1 3/4" Silktop
ingredients.description: Premium dual-disk corks with 100% natural cork on both ends and an agglomerate body for superior sealing. #9 size fits standard 750 ml bottles and is suitable for wines intended for aging. Sold individually.

ingredients.name: Corks 1¾" (#9 Long)
ingredients.description: Standard #9 x 1¾" natural wine corks (24mm x 44mm) designed for 750 ml wine bottles. Creates an effective seal for long term storage and requires a floor or bench corker for insertion. Sold individually.

ingredients.name: Dextrose
ingredients.description: Fermentable glucose sugar used for priming, carbonation, and boosting alcohol content in beer and cider. Ferments cleaner than table sugar with no residual flavor. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Dextrose 500 g package
ingredients.description: Fermentable glucose sugar commonly used for priming bottled beer. Yeast readily ferments it into CO2 for natural carbonation with a clean, neutral flavor profile. 500 g package.

ingredients.name: Dried Rose Hips 3 oz
ingredients.description: Tart, fruity botanical with sweet apple and plum notes used in wines, meads, and specialty herbal beverages. Rich in vitamin C and adds a delicate floral complexity.

ingredients.name: Elderberries 1 oz
ingredients.description: Richly colored, tart berries that add fruit character, body, and color to wines, meads, and porters. Always ferment or heat before use, as raw elderberries should not be consumed.

ingredients.name: Fermaid K 50g
ingredients.description: Blended complex yeast nutrient containing amino acids, sterols, vitamins, and inactive yeast. Promotes vigorous fermentation and compensates for nutrient deficiencies in wine, cider, and mead.

ingredients.name: Fermaid O 100g
ingredients.description: Organic yeast nutrient derived from autolyzed yeast with high amino acid content. Promotes clean fermentation with fewer off-aromas (such as hydrogen sulfide) while enhancing fruit and ester development.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ BE-134 11.5g
ingredients.description:
Recommended for Belgian-style saisons and is characterized by a
particularly high attenuation. It gives fruity aromas with a spicy
character, particularly cloves. This strain will produce highly
refreshing and drinkable beers. Ideal fermentation temperature between
18-28°C (64.4-82.4°F). Slow sedimentation.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ S-04 11.5g
ingredients.description: A well-known, commercial English ale yeast, selected for its fast fermentation character and its ability to form a very compact sediment at the end of the fermentation, helping to improve beer clarity.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ US-05 11.5g
ingredients.description: A ready-to-pitch dry American ale yeast, SafAle US-05 produces well balanced beers with low diacetyl and a very clean, crisp end palate. With medium sedimentations, and medium final gravities, this workhorse of a yeast is a perfect selection for many ale styles.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ W-68 11.5g
ingredients.description:
Suitable for a variety of wheat beers and other styles with fruity-spicy
profiles, Fermentis SafAle™ W-68 produces aromatic beers rich in phenols
(notes of clove and pepper) and esters (floral and fruity banana
flavors). Known for medium sedimentation, this strain forms no clumps
and will appear as a powdery haze when resuspended in beer.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ WB-06 11.5g
ingredients.description: A specialty yeast selected for wheat beer fermentation. The yeast produces subtle estery and phenol flavor notes typical of wheat beers. The choice of Wheat or Weizen bier fans.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafLager™ E-30 11.5g
ingredients.description: Described as the optimal yeast for revealing the esters in Lager beers, Fermentis SafLager™ E-30 produces higher levels of esters than other SafLager™ strains. When fermented at higher temperatures, some subtle isoamyl acetate production is possible. More attenuative than S-33 and S-189, SafLager™ E-30 is low in sulfur and diacetyl production. Featuring nice flocculation and sedimentation, it is suitable for various Asian-style lagers, Mexican lagers, Australasian lagers, American Light lagers and more.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafLager™ W-34/70 11.5g
ingredients.description: This famous brewer’s yeast strain from Weihenstephan in Germany is used worldwide. SafLager™ W-34/70 allows the brewing of beers with a good balance of floral and fruity aromas and gives clean flavors and high drinkable beers.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #1
ingredients.description: Coarse filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing large particulates down to approximately 5 microns. Use as the first filtration stage for young wines.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #2
ingredients.description: Polish filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing particulates down to approximately 1.8 microns. Use as the second stage after coarse filtration for improved clarity.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #3
ingredients.description: Sterile-grade filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing very fine particulates down to approximately 0.5 microns for crystal-clear results. Use as the final polishing stage.

ingredients.name: Floating Thermometer
ingredients.description: Weighted glass thermometer that floats upright in your mash or wort, allowing you to monitor temperature without holding it. Reads in both Fahrenheit and Celsius, making it essential for precise temperature control during all-grain brewing.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Chit Malt
ingredients.description:
Gambrinus Chit Malt is lightly modified and kilned to a low color, so it
retains the high molecular weight proteins that positively impact beer
foam, body, and haze without influencing beer color. Use at up to 10% of
the grist for traditional lagers or hazy IPA, or to improve head and
body in any style; higher percentages can be beneficial when brewing
low-ABV or NA beers.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Munich Dark Malt
ingredients.description:
A very deeply-kilned Munich malt that combines the color and flavor
characteristics of roasted malt with the mellowness of Munich malt. As
up to 30% of the grain bill for dark lagers, Altbier, Doppelbock, dark
Belgian beers, and brown or red ales, Gambrinus Munich Dark 30L adds a
gorgeous red color with notes of bread crust, toffee, brown sugar,
caramel, cereal, and toast.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Munich Light Malt
ingredients.description:
Seeking a well-balanced malty beer?  This plump, sweet, and mellow
Munich malt delivers impressions of toast, pretzel, toffee, and caramel,
with nutty and cereal grain background notes. Ideal as the base malt for
amber or red ales, Altbier, Scottish ales, and traditional Bavarian
lagers; we also recommend small inclusions for pale ale, IPA, and other
styles to intensify color and boost the perception of maltiness without
the sweetness of caramel malt.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Pale Malt
ingredients.description: Our plump 2-row European-style pale ale malt is the base for all beers, and is processed from premium Canadian 2-row barley. Gambrinus Pale Malt is known for its fresh barley and bready character with background notes of biscuit, grain, honey, and hints of nutty and green tea flavor. Use for styles where a rich malt flavor can be shown off, or where a strong malt backbone is needed to balance other strong flavors – IPA, pale ale, brown ale, golden ale, or Scottish and Belgian ales.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Pilsner Malt
ingredients.description:
Processed from the finest Canadian two-row available, this very low
protein base malt is versatile in a wide range of beer styles. Expect
delicate flavors of fresh barley, grain, honey, and bread, along with
distinctive nutty character and suggestions of vanilla when used as the
base for classic Pilsner, Kölsch, pale lager, Belgian ale, session IPA,
and blond ale; or as a portion of the grist for Hefeweizen or Witbier.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Vienna Malt
ingredients.description:
This mellow kilned malt is the missing link between a Pale and Munich
malt. It is ideal for any amber beer, adding a balanced malty character
with strong suggestions of honey, toffee, and caramel. Use at up to 100%
for traditional Vienna, Märzen, and other amber beer styles, or as a
smaller fraction of the grist to add cereal, biscuit, and toasty notes
to pale ale or IPA, Kölsch and blonde ales, or Belgian styles.

ingredients.name: Glass Carboy 19 liter/5 gal
ingredients.description: Five-gallon glass fermentation vessel ideal for smaller batch fermentations, secondary fermentation, and aging. Glass construction will not scratch or retain odors that could impact flavor.

ingredients.name: Glass Carboy 23 liter/6 gal
ingredients.description: Six-gallon glass fermentation vessel with excellent headspace for standard 5-gallon batches. Non-porous glass will not scratch or retain odors, making it ideal for primary, secondary, and bulk aging of beer, wine, and cider.

ingredients.name: Grapefruit Peel 1 oz
ingredients.description: Dried grapefruit peel providing fresh, bright citrus aroma and pleasant bitterness. Add near the end of the boil or during secondary fermentation to enhance IPAs, pale ales, and wheat beers.

ingredients.name: Gypsum (Calcium Sulfate)
ingredients.description: Brewing salt that adjusts water chemistry by adding calcium and sulfate ions, accentuating hop character, improving clarity, and lowering mash pH. Ideal for hop-forward styles and English ales. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Hydrometer Brix/SG/%
ingredients.description: Triple-scale hydrometer that measures specific gravity (SG), Brix, and potential alcohol percentage to monitor fermentation progress and determine alcohol content in beer, wine, cider, and mead.

ingredients.name: Hydrometer Cylinder 10"
ingredients.description: Ten-inch tall plastic test jar with a weighted base for safely floating and reading hydrometers. Requires only a small sample of liquid and features clear graduations for easy measurement reading.

ingredients.name: Hyperdrive RTD Dry Yeast, WHC - 11g
ingredients.description:
A specialized blend of yeast, nutrients and vitamins that contains
everything needed for sugar-based fermentations to produce a clean RTD
base for hard seltzer drinks or as a strong wash for further
distillation into vodka or gin. This yeast can produce a base product of
up to 18% within a five-day fermentation window.

ingredients.name: Irish moss 1 oz
ingredients.description: Natural carrageenan-based clarifying agent added during the last 15 minutes of the boil. Coagulates proteins and tannins to produce clearer, brighter beer with improved cold-break formation.

ingredients.name: Kerry Yeastex® 82
ingredients.description:
Yeastex® 82 is a formulation of specific yeast nutrients to increase yeast viability and activity during fermentation, allowing the end attenuation to be reached in a shorter time, and promoting consistent fermentation profiles.

Yeastex® 82 is a source of zinc and contains high levels of both inorganic and organic nitrogen and vitamins, making it particularly useful when brewing with low FAN malts and in high gravity worts. It should be slurried in a few gallons of water and added to the kettle about 15 minutes before strike-out.

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid 88%
ingredients.description:
88% solution. Used for mash pH adjustment, as well as acid balancing in
seltzers and FMBs.

ingredients.name: Lactose
ingredients.description: Non-fermentable milk sugar that adds subtle sweetness, creamy mouthfeel, and body without increasing alcohol content. Popular in milk stouts, cream ales, and fruit-forward beers. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Lalvin EC-1118 Yeast 5g
ingredients.description: The EC-1118 strain was isolated, studied and selected from Champagne fermentations. Due to its competitive factor and ability to ferment equally well over a wide temperature range, the EC-1118 is one of the most widely used yeasts in the world.

ingredients.name: Malic Acid
ingredients.description: Fruity acid naturally found in apples, commonly used in cider and fruit wine production to adjust acidity and enhance a crisp, tart apple character. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Malto-Dextrin 8oz package
ingredients.description: Non-fermentable dextrin powder that increases body, mouthfeel, and head retention in beer without affecting flavor or alcohol content. Particularly useful in light-bodied extract brews.

ingredients.name: Monster Mill MM-2 3/8" Driveshaft Grain Mill - with Hopper and Base
ingredients.description: Professional two-roller homebrew grain mill featuring two 6-inch steel rollers on an aluminum block frame with adjustable gap. Includes hopper, base, and 3/8" driveshaft that accepts a standard electric drill for consistent grain crushing.

ingredients.name: New Bordeaux Bottles Flint 750 ml
ingredients.description: Clear (flint) glass Bordeaux-shaped 750 ml wine bottles with standard cork finish. Ideal for bottling red wines, whites, meads, and ciders for both home use and gift presentation. Sold individually.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals American Char 2pk
ingredients.description: American oak spirals with charring that provide bold caramelized wood and smoky notes. Adds deep complexity and color stabilization to wine, whiskey, and barrel-aged beer.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals French Medium 2pk
ingredients.description: French oak spirals with medium toast imparting warm vanilla, sweet oak, and subtle cinnamon notes. High surface area design allows full flavor extraction in approximately 6 weeks, making them perfect for carboy-aged wine and spirits.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals French Medium+ 2pk
ingredients.description: French oak spirals with an enhanced toast level offering deeper vanilla, caramel, and toasted bread complexity. Provides refined oak aging character with slightly more intensity than standard medium toast.

ingredients.name: OiO Brewers Rice Hulls
ingredients.description: Parboiled rice hulls improve filter bed performance and reduce the risk of stuck sparge in adjunct-heavy mashes.

ingredients.name: OiO Flaked Corn
ingredients.description:
These are mash ready and will provide subtle flavor and mouthfeel
contributions to beer. Suitable for up to 40% of grist total. This is a
pre-gelatinized flaked grain that does not require milling. 89.9% extract.

ingredients.name: OiO Flaked Rice
ingredients.description:
Rice flakes will provide subtle flavor and mouthfeel contributions to
beer. Suitable for up to 40% of grist total. 89.9% extract.

ingredients.name: OiO Rolled Oat Flakes
ingredients.description:
Mash ready oat flakes will add a distinct full- bodied flavour and
creamy texture. Can be used in amounts of up to 30% of grist total. This
is a pre- gelatinized flaked grain and does not require milling.

ingredients.name: Orange Peel Bitter 1 oz
ingredients.description: Dried Curaçao bitter orange peel adding mild citrus character and subtle bitterness. A classic ingredient in Belgian witbiers, saisons, and holiday ales.

ingredients.name: Orange Peel Sweet 1 oz
ingredients.description: Dried sweet orange peel providing pronounced, pleasant orange flavor and aroma without the bitterness of Curaçao peel. Popular in Belgian strong ales, wheat beers, and specialty brews.

ingredients.name: PBW
ingredients.description: PBW is a buffered alkaline detergent that has been proven to be more than an effective substitute for caustic soda cleaners. Because of its unique formulation of buffers and mild alkalis, it is safe on soft metals such as stainless steel, aluminum, and on plastics. P.B.W. uses active oxygen to penetrate carbon or protein soils and is not affected by hard water. The oxygen also helps in reducing B.O.D. and C.O.D. in wastewater, which is an added environmental benefit.

ingredients.name: PET Carboy 23 liter/6 gal
ingredients.description: Lightweight, BPA-free plastic fermentation vessel with a smooth, ribless design for easy cleaning and sediment observation. Six-gallon capacity is perfect for secondary fermentation and bulk aging of 5-gallon batches.

ingredients.name: Potassium Metabisulphite
ingredients.description:
Commonly used as a wine equipment sanitizer.

Potassium Metabisulfite is also used as an oxidation preventer and microorganism inhibitor in wine. 

To Sanitize Equipment: Use 4 tsp. powder per 1/2 gal. of water. Requires 5 min contact time, drip dry. To Sanitize Wine before adding yeast: Use 1/2 tsp. powder per 6 gal. of wine.

ingredients.name: Potassium Sorbate
ingredients.description: Wine and mead stabilizer that prevents yeast reproduction after fermentation, blocking refermentation in sweetened beverages. Use in combination with potassium metabisulfite for best results. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Racking Cane/Hose Clip 1/2 inch
ingredients.description: Plastic clip that secures a 1/2 inch racking cane in place on your carboy or bucket, allowing controlled lowering to minimize sediment disturbance during transfer.

ingredients.name: Rahr Extra Pale Wheat
ingredients.description: Extra Pale White Wheat malt has the sweet malty flavor of other malted grains, with an irresistible light doughy aroma. Wheat malts are high in protein, which helps produce fuller-bodied beers. Wheat malt can improve head formation and retention, depending upon the other grist constituents. White wheat is easier to mill than red wheat, and more conducive to the haze characteristic of Belgian white beers. Rahr Extra Pale White Wheat is suitable for all wheat-style beers and anywhere its foam-forward contributions will be appreciated.

ingredients.name: Rahr Malted Oats
ingredients.description:
Rahr Malted Oats is your new go-to for adding foam stability and a creamy texture to beer. Ideal for juicy or hazy IPA, stout, porter, or any beer style where increased foam development and silky mouthfeel is desired. Rahr Malted Oats bring earthy, grainy flavors as well as palate fullness.

It is high in protein, but low in color and beta glucans, which reduces the risk of slow or stuck lauter.

ingredients.name: Sarsaparilla Root Mexican 2 oz
ingredients.description: Traditional root beer flavoring ingredient with a slightly bitter, woody character. Natural saponins help produce a foamy head. Pairs well with vanilla, licorice, and wintergreen in homemade soda and root beer recipes.

ingredients.name: Scott'tan Tannin FT Blanc
ingredients.description: Premium gall nut tannin by Scott'Tan designed specifically for white wines, fruit wines, and meads. Provides antioxidant protection, improved mouthfeel, and enhanced perception of body and sweetness. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Scott'tan Tannin Riche
ingredients.description:
Tannin Riche is a cellaring and finishing tannin notable for enhancing complexity.

Derived from 100% toasted French oak, Tannin Riche imparts hints of coconut and vanilla together with a perception of sweet­ness. It can contribute the final touch to your wine.

ingredients.name: Silicon Bung #8 Drilled
ingredients.description: Food-grade silicone stopper with a center hole drilled to fit standard airlocks, designed for use with carboys and fermentation vessels. Durable, heat-resistant, and will not impart flavors to your brew.

ingredients.name: Simpsons Maris Otter
ingredients.description: Premium English heritage base malt with low nitrogen and high extract, delivering rich, slightly nutty flavor with biscuit and bread crust notes. Ideal for traditional British ales, bitters, and pale ales.

ingredients.name: Star San Sanitizer 8oz
ingredients.description: Five Star's trusted no-rinse acid-based sanitizer for homebrewing and winemaking equipment. Dilute 1 oz per 5 gallons of water and it sanitizes on contact in under 2 minutes with natural foaming action. 8 oz bottle.

ingredients.name: Tartaric Acid
ingredients.description: The primary acid naturally present in grapes and the preferred choice for adjusting acidity in grape wines. Highly stable and integrates seamlessly without microbial breakdown. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Thomas Fawcett Pale Chocolate Malt
ingredients.description: Lightly roasted English specialty malt with mild chocolate and coffee notes, less intense than regular chocolate malt. Adds complexity and color to dark milds, brown ales, porters, and stouts.

ingredients.name: Verdant IPA Dry Ale Yeast, LalBrew® Lallemand - 11g
ingredients.description: Verdant IPA yeast is highly versatile and well suited for NEIPAs, Hazy IPAs, English IPAs and Bitters, American Pale Ales, Stouts, and many other beer styles. Specially selected in collaboration with Verdant Brewing Co. in the UK for its ability to produce a wide variety of hop-forward and malty beers. Prominent notes of apricot and undertones of tropical fruit and citrus merge seamlessly with hop aromas. With medium-high attenuation, LalBrew® Verdant IPA leaves a soft and balanced malt profile with slightly more body than a typical American IPA yeast strain.

ingredients.name: Weyermann CARAFA Special Type 2
ingredients.description: Dehusked (debittered) dark roasted malt with smooth coffee, cocoa, and chocolate flavors. Adds deep color and body without the harsh astringency of standard roasted malts. Excellent in schwarzbier, porter, and stout.

ingredients.name: Weyermann Floor-Malted Bohemian Pilsner
ingredients.description: Traditionally floor-malted Czech lager malt with earthy character and notes of biscuit and honey. Produces pale golden wort perfect for authentic Bohemian pilsners and European-style lagers.

ingredients.name: Wine Conditioner 500 mL
ingredients.description:
To be added to wine after stabilizing and clearing to sweeten to taste.
Recommended dosage: 7 mL/L (1 ½ tsp/L)

ingredients.name: Wine Thief 3pc Plastic
ingredients.description: Three-piece plastic sampling tool approximately 18 inches long that collects small samples without agitation or aeration. Disassembles for easy cleaning and allows testing with a hydrometer or by taste.
